title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #09 (AmericanArtDeco+FinnishIittala+EthiopianCrossLattice+RomanianHorezu / UkrainianPetrykivka+VasarelyOpArt+VietnameseSonMai+RussianPalekh / PeruvianNazca+MoroccanZellige+TurkishIznik+NigerianAdire)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Ethiopian woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, cool and composed, warm honey-blonde hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes. Long oval nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands, dense zigzag linework) dominates one zone. Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, wide cream bands, dense concentric ripple linework) dominates the second zone. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates the third zone. Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands, dense spiral floral bands) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Left woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, bold and confident, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands, dense folk-art florals) dominates one zone. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates the second zone. Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands, dense eggshell-white scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands, dense jewel-toned scenework) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult American woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, cheerful, pure icy-white hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands, dense stepped geometric borders) dominates one zone. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates the second zone. Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands, dense floral scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs, wide white bands, dense spiral resist motifs) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Right woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform wedges, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
